issues.title: Missing slot in OTP group
issues.description: The OTP input displays only five total slots despite specifying a 6-character code requirement.
issues.evidence: Right OTP group contains only two slots (one populated with '2' and one empty slot), leaving 5 slots total across the control.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing sixth InputOTPSlot to complete the second InputOTPGroup.
issues.triageNote: No slot is actually missing (eval page and demo both render 6 slots); the real defect is that empty inactive slot borders are near-invisible in dark theme (border-input rgb(42 41 38) over a near-black canvas ≈ 1.3:1), so the last empty slot read as absent — stepped the dark resting border to muted-foreground/70 (≈3.3:1) with brighter dark active/invalid counterparts.

issues.title: Inconsistent OTP Group Styling
issues.description: The filled OTP slot group has an irregular outer border and padding artifact not present on the empty group.
issues.evidence: The right group of slots containing '4', 'K', '7' displays a thick outer border container, unlike the left group.
issues.suggestion: Normalize border tokens and container styles across all InputOTPGroup elements.
issues.triageNote: Confirmed by eval agent: physical border-r / first:border-l / first:rounded-l-md / last:rounded-r-md do not mirror in RTL, so each group's outer edge loses border+rounding on one side (plus a doubled inner divider); replaced with logical border-e / first:border-s / first:rounded-s-md / last:rounded-e-md (same idiom as ui/button-group).

issues.title: Inconsistent slot group styling
issues.description: The first and second OTP groups render with mismatched slot container styles and backgrounds.
issues.evidence: Slots 1-3 display as distinct white cards, whereas slots 4-6 render inside a single connected grey container.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent slot background and border tokens across both groups.
issues.triageNote: Both groups render with identical token classes and LTR output is unchanged; the perceived mismatch is the standard segmented grouping dividers plus the by-design active-slot highlight (ring-[3px] + border-ring on the next empty slot, index 3 for value 'K7A').
